hook: Need (要) + hope (望): what you need and hope for becomes a request.
Extra (余) + free time (暇): your leftover free time is leisure.
Extra (余) + fun (興): extra fun at a party, the side entertainment.
Leave in care (預) + money (金): money you leave with the bank, a deposit.
Hold down (抑) + pressure (圧): pressing people down hard, oppression.
Bathe (浴) + room (室): the room where you bathe.
Hold down (抑) + control (制): holding something down to keep it under control.
Desire (欲) + deep (深い): someone whose wants go very deep is greedy.
Want (欲) + wish (望): strong wants and wishes, desire.
Before (予) + words (言): words said before it happens, a prediction.
Good (良): shout 'Yoshi!' when something is good, all right!
Good (善し) + bad (悪し): the good and bad points of something.
Another place (余所) + look (見): looking at another place, looking away.
Extra (余) + ground (地): extra ground left over, room or margin.
Take part (与) + party (党): the party that takes part in governing, the ruling party.
Call (呼び) + stop (止める): call out to someone to make them stop.
Night (夜) + grow late (更し): letting the night grow late, staying up late.
Night (夜) + grow late (更け): the deep, late part of the night.
Extra (余) + degree (程): to an extra degree, very much.
Read (読み) + raise (上げる): read it up and out loud for everyone.
Come close (寄り) + hang (掛かる): move close and hang your weight on it, lean.
Society (世) + opinion (論): what society thinks, public opinion.
Weak (弱): to become weak, or to be in a weak spot (troubled).
Come (来) + place (場): coming to the place or venue, attendance.
Milk products (酪) + farming (農): dairy farming.
Fall (落) + down (下): falling down, a drop.
Easy, happy (楽) + view (観): a happy view of things, optimism.
Too much (濫) + use (用): using something too much, misuse.
Logic (理) bent (屈) to fit your side: a reason or theory, often an excuse.
Profit (利) + child (子): the 'child' your money gives birth to, interest.
Profit (利) + enrich (潤): profit that makes you rich, returns.
Logic (理) + nature (性): the logical part of your nature, reason.
Profit (利) + breath (息): your money 'breathes out' more money, interest.
Stand (立) + body (体): a body that stands up in 3D, a solid.
Stand (立) + square (方): a square that stands up in 3D, a cube.
Set up (立) + law (法): setting up laws, lawmaking.
Benefit (利) + point (点): a good point, an advantage.
Seize (略) + snatch (奪): grabbing things by force, looting.
Shorten (略) + word (語): a shortened word, an abbreviation.
Flow (流) + pass through (通): goods and money flowing through, distribution.
Rule (領) + area (域): an area you rule, a territory or field.
Territory (領) + sea (海): the sea a country owns.
Both (両) + pole (極): both poles, both extremes.
Good (良) + like (好): good and liked, going well.
Good (良) + knowledge (識): good judgement, good sense.
Good (良) + quality (質): good quality.
Good (良) + heart (心): the good heart inside you, your conscience.
Rule (領) + land (地): land that someone rules, territory.
Rule (領) + soil (土): the soil a country rules, its territory.
Both (両) + stand (立): two things both standing together, doing both well.
Travel (旅) + guest (客): a travelling guest, a passenger.
Travel (旅) + ticket (券): your ticket to travel abroad, a passport.
Logic (理) + argument (論): a logical argument, a theory.
Woods (林) + industry (業): the work of forests, forestry.
Similar kind (類) + infer (推): guessing from similar cases, analogy.
Kind (類) + resemble (似): of a similar kind, alike.
Cold (冷) + cruel (酷): cold and cruel, ruthless.
Cold (冷) + faint (淡): cold, faint feelings, indifference.
Start (発) + illness (病): the moment an illness starts.
First (初) + ear (耳): something your ears hear for the first time.
End (果): to come to the very end, be finished or worn out.
甚 means extreme: はなはだ means extremely, very greatly.
Flowery splendor (華) said twice: full of splendor, brilliant and spectacular.
Flowery splendor (華): bright and gorgeous like flowers (はな).
阻 means block: to block someone, stop them from doing something.
Beach (浜) + side (辺): the edge of the beach, the shore.
Early, fast (早): to make something earlier or faster.
Belly (腹) + stand up (立ち): your belly 'stands up' when you get angry.
Field, plain (原): a wide open field where kids play.
Far off (遥): far, far away, distant.
Break (破) + split (裂): breaking and splitting open, bursting.
Sounds like 晴れる, but 腫 (flesh radical 月) means swelling: your skin swells up.
Grow thick (繁) + flourish (栄): growing and flourishing, prosperity.
Printing block (版) + picture (画): a picture printed from a block.
Against (反) + feeling (感): a feeling against someone, dislike.
Back (反) + echo (響): sound coming back, an echo or response.
Back (反) + attack (撃): attacking back, a counterattack.
Judge (判) + decide (決): the judge's decision, the verdict.
Busy, thick (繁) + full (盛): a shop busy and full, thriving.
Grow thick (繁) + increase (殖): increasing in number, breeding.
Half (半) + edge (端): stopped halfway at the edge, incomplete.
Back (反) + shoot out (発): shooting back, pushing back against.
Against (反) + disorder (乱): rising against rulers in disorder, rebellion.
Spread (氾) + overflow (濫): both have water (氵), water spreading over, a flood.
Hold back, wait (控) + room (室): the room where you wait.
Sad (悲) + view (観): a sad view of things, pessimism (opposite of 楽観).
Pull (引き) + up (上げる): pull up and pull out, withdraw.
率 means lead: it sounds like 引き (pull) + いる, you pull your team along.
Pull (引き) + raise up (起こす): pull something up into happening, to cause.
Pull (引) + lower (下げる): pull down, lower.
Pull (引き) + 'zuru', the sound of dragging: drag something along.
Pull (引) + take (取る): take something back into your care, or take yourself away.
No (否) + decide (決): decide no, vote it down.
Sad (悲) + miserable (惨): terribly sad and miserable, tragic.
Compare (比) + weight (重): comparing weights, specific gravity.
Secret (秘) + writing (書): the person who handles secret papers, a secretary.
Not (不) + straight (正) make 歪: not straight, warped.
Secret (密): done in secret, privately.
浸 has water (氵): put something in water, soak or dip it.
Left (左) + works well (利き): your left hand works best, left-handed.
Pull (引っ) + scratch (掻く): drag your nails, scratch.
Must (必) + study (修): a subject you must study, required.
Must (必) + so (然): it must be so, inevitable.
Match (匹) + rival (敵): a match for your rival, equal to them.
One (一) + breath (息): one breath, a short pause.
One (一) + time (頃): at one time back then, once.
Person (人) + pledge (質): a person held as a pledge, a hostage.
One (一) + line (筋): one single line, following one path with all your heart.
雛 has 隹 (bird): a young bird, a chick, or a doll.
Doll (雛) + festival (祭): the doll festival for girls on March 3.
Sun (日) + facing (向): a place facing the sun, in the sun.
Wrong (非) + find fault (難): saying someone did wrong, criticism.
Sun (日) + circle (丸): the red sun circle, Japan's flag.
Fire (火) + flower (花): little flowers of fire, sparks.
Sad (悲) + cry (鳴): a cry of pain or fear, a scream.
Cool (冷): cool someone off by teasing them, make fun of.
Mark, sign (標) + words (語): words on a sign, a slogan.
Flat (平): flat and even.
Compare (比) + rate (率): a rate found by comparing, a ratio.
